house-yard.context: Reolink E1 Outdoor Pro 4K PTZ camera (192.168.0.88); currently aimed at the yard, sky, and coop approach

usb-webcam-1080p.context: Cheap generic USB webcam (UVC, 1920x1080, lower image quality than the S7) looking out over open grass bounded by blue-and-white electric poultry netting, with woods behind and farm buildings and vehicles off to one side. Subjects: adult and adolescent chickens, mixed rare/exotic breeds — the whole flock is grown or nearly grown now. NO chicks in this view. Birds range in and out of frame and can pass very close to the lens; large parts of a frame are often just empty grass. Camera angle is fixed. Score conservatively — this is a budget sensor and a 7 here is a genuinely good shot for this camera. Served on port 8090 of the Raspberry Pi 5 'farm-pi5' at Birdcatraz (moved there 05-Aug-2026 from GWTC; previously the MacBook Air). This camera is INTERMITTENT — it has a long history of losing its video function and serving black frames; on the Pi its V4L2 gain was found pinned at 0 and restored to 32, but that fix is UNCONFIRMED pending a daylight test.

s7-cam.context: Samsung Galaxy S7 running IP Webcam, mains-powered from a 3 A USB charger at BIRDCATRAZ — the outdoor enclosed poultry compound (chicken coop plus turkey pen) where the whole flock lives. Samsung ISOCELL S5K2L1 sensor, 1920x1080, f/1.7 — the best camera in the fleet, so judge it on its own merits rather than grading it against the cheap webcams. AIMED GENERALLY AT THE FLOCK, not at any one feature. Expect a mix: turkeys, bantams, standard-size hens and roosters, mixed rare and exotic breeds, in natural daylight. Any of them may pass close to the lens or stay far off. These birds are grown or nearly grown — this is NOT a brooder and there are NO chicks. Portrait orientation (1080x1920).

gwtc.context: Gateway laptop built-in webcam (1280x720, fixed focus, lower quality), mounted on the ROOF OF THE COOP pointing down for an overhead/approach view of the coop run and surrounding area. Subjects: adult chickens and older feathered chicks in the coop run, or the yard/approach area — whatever is below the camera. NO turkey poults, NO young bantam chicks. Angle is overhead so you may see bird backs and tops of heads rather than faces. Images may have compression artifacts (vertical stripes, smearing) from H.264 decode issues — tag those as blurred. Score conservatively for this low-resolution overhead camera.

macbook-air-facetime.context: MacBook Air 2013 built-in FaceTime HD camera (1280x720), served on port 8089 of 192.168.0.50 by its own usb-cam-host instance (LaunchAgent com.farmguardian.cam-macbook-air-facetime). MOVED 2026-06-21 from the brooder to the TURKEY PEN (part of BIRDCATRAZ, the outdoor enclosed poultry area): an outdoor wire-fenced enclosure in natural daylight. The MacBook Air sits on a ledge inside the pen; the built-in camera looks across the pen through wire mesh toward the grass beyond, so much of the frame is fence and bedding. Subjects: the turkeys kept in this pen, often out of frame. This is NOT the brooder and there are NO baby chicks here. Lowest picture quality of the three cameras on this host — score conservatively. NOTE: this camera disappears from the system entirely when the laptop's lid is shut, and the service then serves nothing rather than substituting another camera.

jieli-dashcam.context: Car dashboard camera (Jieli Technology 'USB PHY 2.0', 1280x720, wide-angle) running in PC-camera mode, served on port 8091 of the MacBook Air by its own usb-cam-host instance. ⚠️ DO NOT DESCRIBE WHAT THIS CAMERA IS POINTED AT, AND DO NOT ADD A SCENE DESCRIPTION HERE. It gets re-aimed frequently and deliberately — any 'it looks at the yard / the coop / the pen' text written here goes stale within days and then actively misleads the model. Describe only the DEVICE. Judge each frame on what is actually in it. Wide-angle lens, so subjects are often small and there may be visible barrel distortion and tilt; that is normal for this camera and is not a fault. Best picture quality of the three cameras on this host. Served on port 8091 of the Raspberry Pi 5 'farm-pi5' at Birdcatraz (moved there 05-Aug-2026 from the MacBook Air). Frames are served with NO image processing of any kind — what you see is exactly what the sensor produced.

dominator-cam.context: MSI Dominator GT72 6QD (Windows 10, 192.168.0.194) built-in BisonCam NB Pro webcam. Opportunistic — only live when Boss double-clicks the desktop shortcut. Aim varies.

duo2.context: Reolink Duo 2 WiFi (dual-lens 180 pano, fixed), lens 01, IP .155 (WiFi, DHCP — drifted from .14/.15 after 4-Jul-2026 ethernet→WiFi flip). Stationary complement to the E1 PTZ. Zone TBD - confirm mount/aim with Boss.
